conditions: Ohmic element with constant resistance at fixed physical conditions, passive sign convention and negligible reactive effects.

evidence: An ideal ohmic element has a linear voltage-current relationship through the origin with constant resistance R under fixed conditions. Its slope is R, giving V=IR, including zero current. This is an empirical constitutive model; a general nonlinear element does not obey a constant-R law.
Reference checked 2026-11-27: https://openstax.org/books/university-physics-volume-2/pages/9-key-equations. Proposed maintainer approval, not independent human certification.
